items.title: Pura doubles down on brand collaborations: ‘We want to be the Spotify of fragrance’
items.why: Collaboration-led subscriber retention is a model card loyalty teams could borrow for co-branded experience perks.
items.summary_ai: Pura is expanding brand collaborations, including with New York City Ballet and Calm, to keep subscribers.
items.take: Collaboration-led subscriber retention is a model card loyalty teams could borrow for co-branded experience perks.
